migration_rules: Do not move a live entrypoint until its supervisor command and all importers use a compatibility shim.
Do not copy, compact, rename, or rewrite immutable evidence as part of source reorganization.
A source, feature, label, model, cost, or allocator contract change creates a new cohort identity.
Research cannot promote; reports cannot mutate; evidence cannot authorize; execution cannot reinterpret lifecycle state.
Only Practice 007 may execute, and only through the existing exact canary authorization boundary.
Every migrated module must pass its focused tests and the structure audit before the old path is retired.

migration_phases.objective: Inventory and assign ownership without moving live code.
Extract shared contracts and pure utilities behind compatibility imports.
Move read-only ingestion and monitoring workers one domain at a time.
Move research and evidence builders with replay equivalence tests.
Move governance and execution last; retain old entrypoint shims through a full practice validation window.
Archive retired root scripts only after no importer, supervisor, test, or runbook references them.
